Name: OD's Better Side Krobus
Author: ODMods
Description:
[size=5]OD's Better Side Krobus[/size]

This attempts to make Krobus' side sprites be a bit more appealing

[size=4]About the Mod
[/size]
This is a very small mod, but it's one that I found useful. I love Krobus so much, but I could not get over his side-facing sprite. I changed it with a Content Patcher mod and thought there might be another person who had this problem too.

[size=4]Installation[/size]

1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Install Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).
3. Download this mod and unzip it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Launch the game via SMAPI.

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+
- Content Patcher 2.4+

[size=4]Credits[/size]

Made by OD Mods.
